test_title: PYST 04: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is not a part of the Directive Principles of State Policy of the Constitution of India?

options.text: Protection and improvement of environment and protection of forests and wild life.
Protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance
The provision of early childhood care and education for children under the age of six.
Provision for protection of minority areas in Rajasthan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Provision for protection of minority areas in Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government. These principles are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• **Protection and improvement of environment and protection of forests and wild life,** is covered under Article 48A of the Directive Principles.
 
• **Protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance** is included under Article 49.
 
• **The provision of early childhood care and education for children under the age of six** falls under Article 45.
 
• **Provision for protection of minority areas in Rajasthan** is not a part of the Directive Principles of State Policy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy are enshrined in Part IV of the Constitution of India, from Articles 36 to 51.
 
• They aim to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can lead a good life.
 
• These principles emphasize that the state should strive to promote the welfare of the people by securing and protecting a social order in which justice—social, economic, and political—shall inform all the institutions of national life.
